data.long_meaning: From the German words groß (large) and Mann (man). The name Grossman was originally used to describe a large or heavy man. The name Grossman carries the meaning “Large, heavy man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Grossman usually hope their child will grow to embody large, heavy man and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Grossman total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_significance: In a Christian context, the name Grossman can take on spiritual meanings. One interpretation is that it represents the belief in the physical and spiritual strength of a person in their faith. The "gross" or large aspect could signify a deep inner wisdom and understanding, akin to the Christian idea of being "born again" with a spiritual largeness. Alternatively, it may serve as a reminder of the importance of exceeding the limitations of the physical body, transcending material growth, and focusing on spiritual growth. In this sense, the "mann," or man, aspect emphasizes the individual accountability of each person to draw closer to God.
